messages:
Tariq: Ran a 14d shortfall sim for apac-hosted. If growth stays ~+18% wk/wk we exhaust committed p4-equivalent by day 9. Need quick mitigations (spillover, throttle, or reservation buy).
Maria: Can you paste the sim numbers and assumptions?
Tariq: Snapshot:
```
Assumptions: +18% wk/wk traffic, heavy embedding batches overnight
Committed (p4-equiv): 80
Forecasted peak demand (p4-equiv): 120
Headroom: -40 GPUs
Billing overage observed: +18% in last 48h vs forecast
Estimate: stockout ~D+9 without action
```
Infra-bot: billing-scan detected untagged burst instances in project redwood-hosted-apac — est cost impact $12,300 in last 48h. https://billing.internal/redwood/alerts/1034
Sam: Oof. Can we route bulk embeddings to eu for the next 72h? Latency acceptable for batch jobs, not for chat.
Elaine: EU has limited spare reserved capacity; won't cover full -40 gap. Also note network egress will increase if we shift heavy volume.
Tariq: Quick playbook proposal:
- throttle embedding batch_size -> 16 (reduce peak ~20%)
- enable routing rule preferring eu for embedding pipeline (canary 5% -> ramp to 25% if stable)
- reclaim untagged burst VMs (Infra-bot ticket)
- open cloud quota spike request for apac (temporary soft limit raise)
Commands I ran:
```
# throttle
rctl update route embeddings --batch-size 16
# canary routing
rctl route set embeddings --region-preference eu --canary 0.05
```
Maria: I'll open a billing investigation for the untagged VMs and run a tighter what-if: buy 40 reserved GPUs vs. 3 days of overage + spillover costs.
Elaine: Pinged Platform-Finance for a rapid cost calc. Finance-bot created FIN-2345 for reservation vs overage analysis.
Finance-bot: FIN-2345 created — assignee: @Maria, due 48h. Link: https://finance.internal/tickets/FIN-2345
Sam: If routing toggle is safe, I'll run the canary this afternoon and watch p99 latency for chat routes. Will halt if we see regressions.
Tariq: Action items summarized:
- Maria: billing ticket + what-if (48h)
- Elaine: coordinate finance calc with Platform-Finance
- Sam: run canary and monitor latencies
- Infra-bot: reclaim untagged instances
I'll follow up with a short runbook for temporary throttles and fallback policies. :thumbsup:
